slices.title: Run-control bus seam, ACL, two-replica profile (dark)
slices.summary: Adds a RunControl module with Off, Loopback and Nats transports and a timeout-bounded request/reply, the mp.v1.runctl subjects in mp-events, the runctl ACL in deploy/nats.conf, and a dark MODEL_GATEWAY_RUN_CONTROL_BUS flag. Adds a two-replica compose overlay whose replica B is on 127.0.0.1:18080 and metrics on 19090 (K2-5), not 8081 and 9091, so it does not collide with Ingestion or session-core ports.
slices.flag: MODEL_GATEWAY_RUN_CONTROL_BUS (off by default; on enables the bus; a boot self-test that finds a permission violation degrades to off); MODEL_GATEWAY_RUN_CONTROL_TIMEOUT_MS (default 750, clamped 100-5000); MODEL_PLANE_REPLICAS (compose.sh, default 1)
slices.needs_external: DEC-07 ruling (D1 NATS request/reply, D2 503 down-behaviour) before merge, and ops sign-off on the nats.conf ACL change via the WS01 deploy.

slices.title: Shared stream cancel and durable-cancel fan-out
slices.summary: A Stop on a replica that does not own the stream reaches the owner over the bus: each cancel-registry entry holds a remote listener on the per-request and per-run cancel subjects, and invoke_cancel and cancel_run answer 202 peer, 404 no owner, or 503 run_control_unavailable. Per K1-7 this slice lands the run-keyed cancel subject with a no-op loop observer; WS03-S3 plugs the observation point later and does not gate this slice.
slices.flag: MODEL_GATEWAY_RUN_CONTROL_BUS (same switch as S1; off means no listener and no bus traffic)
test_commands: cd 'apps/Model Plane/rust' && cargo test -q -p model-gateway --test run_control_two_replica_test

slices.title: Shared queued input and cross-replica liveness
slices.summary: Queue and probe ops go over the run-control bus so queued input and resume liveness work from any replica: the ZDR and waived gate runs before any queue text leaves the replica, enqueue becomes checked (thread mismatch 409, duplicate op_id returns the same item, bounded seen-ops), and the resume tail uses a cached cross-replica probe in place of the local-only producer check. Persist still follows enqueue in this slice; the reorder is S6 (D3).
slices.flag: MODEL_GATEWAY_RUN_CONTROL_BUS (same switch as S1; queue and probe ops ride it)
slices.needs_external: DEC-07 owner ruling before merge (D1 NATS request/reply, D2 503, D3 persist-before-deliver correction).

slices.title: Durable plan grant
slices.summary: Makes a plan-mode grant durable in session-core: SetRunModeRequest gains approved_plan_id = 6, a new ThreadAutonomy service with GetThreadGrant reads the thread's grant, and set_run_mode writes the grant columns in the same transaction. The gateway resolves the rung and approved plan from session-core, so a Do run started on another replica carries the rung; the in-memory coordinator grant stays unused while the flag is on.
slices.flag: MODEL_GATEWAY_DURABLE_PLAN_GRANT (default off; off keeps the in-memory grants of WS14 S2a)
slices.needs_external: DEC-08 owner ruling (D5 plan-grant carrier = session-core columns) before merge.

slices.title: Shared turn record
slices.summary: Mirrors the turn-to-run identifiers into a best-effort Redis record (ids only, identity-scoped key, 24 h TTL) so feedback sent to another replica resolves a turn that streamed elsewhere. PreviousTurnRegistry stays local, and the mirror reuses the stream-buffer breaker.
slices.flag: MODEL_GATEWAY_SHARED_TURN_RECORD (default off; flipped on in S9)

slices.title: Durable send receipts
slices.summary: Gives each sent or queued message an identity the transcript can dedupe on: AppendMessageRequest.client_message_id = 18, AppendMessageResponse message_id = 2 and deduplicated = 3, a unique (thread_id, client_message_id) index, and a lookup in append_message_in_tx before the insert. Queued input persists before it is enqueued (closes D3), and the SPA tray reports delivered, not delivered, or resent. Behind MODEL_GATEWAY_SEND_RECEIPTS (default off).
slices.flag: MODEL_GATEWAY_SEND_RECEIPTS (default off; the SPA sends client_message_id regardless of the flag, and omits it for ZDR)

slices.title: Shared idempotency claim and attach
slices.summary: Adds an optional Redis SET NX claim on the scoped idempotency key (ids only; Pending 120 s, Done 600 s) so a duplicate send that lands on another replica attaches to the original run; the local registry stays first. The resume replay path shares one refactored helper with the in-flight and cached states, and the unary /v1/invoke path stays per-replica.
slices.flag: MODEL_GATEWAY_SHARED_IDEMPOTENCY (default off; stays off in S9; own proof before any flip)
